solution.text:
The region is the triangle with vertices (0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0). For 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, its upper bound-
ary is y = x; for 1 ≤ x ≤ 2, it is y = 2 − x. The lower boundary is zero throughout. Reversal
requires splitting where the active upper boundary changes.
